usageNotes: Returns the sub-resource directory index for a specific Ceph cluster registered in PDM. Use it to discover what child endpoints are available under a given cluster identifier before drilling into status, OSDs, pools, or health. The cluster name must match a cluster already registered with PDM; an unknown or mis-spelled name will return a 404.

examples.summary: List available sub-resources for the cluster named 'prod-ceph'

tips: The response type is null in the schema, meaning PDM returns a directory index (list of child links) rather than structured data — parse the 'data' array for available sub-paths.
This endpoint requires no special privilege beyond authenticated access ('user: all'), so any valid API token can call it.
Use this as a discovery call when you are unsure which sub-operations (e.g., health, OSDs, pools) are exposed for a cluster in your PDM version.
